'''Marren Atma''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] army [[Defense Coordinator]] with the [[Balmorran resistance]]. He was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] around [[3643 BBY]], when he was killed.<ref name="Firestar" />

==Behind the scenes==
Marren Atma appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Balmorra. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.<ref name="Firestar" />
